checkRuns.command:
kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "bun server.js"; sleep 0.5
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.5
u=http://localhost:4701; A="Accept: text/html"
for o in http://localhost:4701 http://127.0.0.1:4701 http://evil.example; do h=${o#http://}; [ "$h" = evil.example ] && h=localhost:4701; echo -n "$o -> "; curl -s -X POST -H "$A" -H "Origin: $o" -H "Host: $h" --data-urlencode "name= Ada " --data-urlencode "email=ada@example.com" --data-urlencode "message=This is a long enough message." http://127.0.0.1:4701/contact -o /tmp/out.html -w "%{http_code} "; grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*' /tmp/out.html || echo; done
curl -s -X POST -H "$A" -H "Origin: $u" --data-urlencode "name=  " --data-urlencode "email= bad " --data-urlencode "message=short" $u/contact | grep -o 'value="[^"]*"\|<textarea[^<]*'
curl -s $u/books/nope | grep -c 'aria-current'; curl -s $u/books/dracula | grep -c 'aria-current="page"'; curl -s $u/contact | grep -o '<a[^>]*aria-current[^>]*>'
ss -ltnp | grep 4701; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/bookshelf.log 2>&1 &
P=$!; sleep 1.5
for p in / /books /books/treasure-island /about /contact /missing; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4702$p; done
kill $P; sleep 1; ss -ltnp | grep -c 4702

docs.source: https://svelte.dev/llms.txt and the files it links
